questions.stem: Which of the following is the name of India's first mission to the Moon?
choices: Chandrayaan-1
Chandrayaan-2
Chandrayaan-3
Chandrayaan-4
questions.solution: Chandrayaan-1 was India's first mission to the Moon, launched in 2008. Subsequent missions, such as Chandrayaan-2 and Chandrayaan-3, were launched later and are not the first. Chandrayaan-4 is not a real mission and does not exist.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा चंद्रमा पर भारत के पहले मिशन का नाम है?

hi.solution: चंद्रयान-1 भारत का चंद्रमा पर पहला मिशन था, जिसे 2008 में लॉन्च किया गया था। बाद में चंद्रयान-2 और चंद्रयान-3 जैसे अन्य मिशन लॉन्च किए गए और वे पहले नहीं हैं। चंद्रयान-4 एक वास्तविक मिशन नहीं है और अस्तित्व में नहीं है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses standard Indian terminology for space missions.

questions.stem: What is the main reason why comets have tails?
choices: They reflect sunlight from their surfaces
They are made up of dust, gases, rocks and ice
They are made up of metal and rock
They are made up of water and ice
questions.solution: The main reason comets have tails is that they are made up of dust, gases, rocks, and ice. When comets approach the Sun, the heat causes the ice to sublimate, creating the visible tail. The other options do not accurately describe the composition of comets or explain the formation of their tails.

questions.stem: If a comet is observed near the Sun, what would happen to its tail?
choices: It would disappear
It would become longer
It would shrink
It would change color
questions.solution: As a comet approaches the Sun, solar radiation and solar wind cause the comet's frozen materials to vaporize, creating a tail. This process increases the size of the tail, making it longer when the comet is near the Sun. The other options are incorrect because the tail does not disappear, shrink, or change color due to proximity to the Sun.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct statement about the Moon?
choices: It has a thick atmosphere
It has water and life
It has no atmosphere, water, or life
It has a lot of vegetation
questions.solution: The correct statement is that the Moon has no atmosphere, water, or life, as these are well-established scientific facts. The Moon's surface lacks the conditions necessary to support an atmosphere, liquid water, or any form of life. Other options are incorrect because they describe features that do not exist on the Moon.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about the Milky Way Galaxy?
choices: It is the largest galaxy in the universe
It contains millions to billions of stars
It is the only galaxy in the universe
It is a star that produces heat and light
questions.solution: The correct option is that the Milky Way Galaxy contains millions to billions of stars, which is a characteristic of galaxies in general. The other options are incorrect because no single galaxy is the largest in the universe, the Milky Way is not the only galaxy, and a galaxy is not a single star.

questions.stem: If a spacecraft lands on the Moon, which of the following is most likely to be true about the Moon’s surface?
choices: It has a thick atmosphere
It has a lot of water
It has no atmosphere or water
It has a dense vegetation
questions.solution: The Moon lacks an atmosphere and water because it does not have the gravitational pull to retain gases or the conditions necessary to support liquid water. The presence of a thick atmosphere, a lot of water, or dense vegetation would require different environmental conditions that are not present on the Moon.

hi.solution: चंद्रमा के पास वायुमंडल या पानी नहीं है क्योंकि यह गैसों को धारण करने के लिए गुरुत्वाकर्षण का आकर्षण नहीं रखता है या तरल जल के समर्थन के लिए आवश्यक परिस्थितियां नहीं हैं। एक मोटी वायुमंडल, बहुत ज्यादा पानी या घना वनस्पति की उपस्थिति अलग पर्यावरणीय परिस्थितियों की आवश्यकता होती है जो चंद्रमा पर उपलब्ध नहीं है।
